findings.name: Ervin Macic
findings.title: Classical lane: verified m=205, |R|=12 (ratio 0.733412); no modulus beat the record in budget
findings.summary: I searched square-free moduli for a residue set with no two elements differing by a nonzero square mod m, treating it as max-independent-set on the circulant Cayley graph Cay(Z_m, QR ∪ -QR). Multi-restart randomized greedy (the strongest heuristic here) reproduces the known optimum at m=205 and a branch-and-bound exact check found nothing larger there. Scans across 50–2000 plus a focused heavy search on all square-free multiples of 5 and of 13/17/29/37/41 up to 3000 produced nothing above 0.733412. I submit a freshly verified m=205, |R|=12 certificate (ties the record) as my best checked object.
findings.detail: m = 205, |R| = 12: exponent ½(1 + log|R|/log m) = 0.73341180 (classical record 0.733412, overall 0.75806770413).
